exact: envenomation resulting in fibrinogenolysis in another organism
envenomation resulting in fibrinogenolysis in other organism

definition: A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances fibrinogenolysis in another organism via the action of a venom. Fibrinogenolysis is the degradation of fibrinogen by proteolytic cleavage.
label: venom-mediated fibrinogenolysis
